GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Rider reported his mount travelled comfortably at the rear throughout early & middle stages. He said passing 600m, as runners began to fan, he was able to improve along rail into running available in advance of mount. He said that on straightening he observed runner shift away from the rail & commenced to position mount to the inside of that runner; however, as he did so, it shifted back in towards the rail, resulting in him steadying mount & directing it to the outside of that runner. He added that mount clear from 250m but didn't quicken. Post race vet no abs.
